description: Produces the music cues on an audited checklist, following the music bible, including the adaptive layers and loop points each cue calls for. Writes to staging; does not wire anything up.
when_to_use: a music checklist exists and the tracks have to be made
the request is to compose or generate music
avoid_when: the files exist and only need importing
the audio wanted is sound effects
outputs: music files in the staging area
